text: Easy 10k this morning, 55 min, HR 138. Legs felt heavy after yesterday's workout.
Long run 28 km at 5:40/km, avg heart rate 146. Felt good until km 24, then calf tightness.
Track: 6 x 800m intervals with 400m jog recovery. RPE 8. Felt great.
Tempo 8 km in 36:00, threshold effort, hr 162.
Rest day, knee pain on the stairs so I skipped the run.
6 miles recovery shuffle, super slow, 62 minutes. Felt ok.
Half marathon race! 21.1 km in 1:39:30, new PB. Avg HR 171, rpe 9.
Did the club's Tuesday session, nothing crazy, maybe a 6 out of 10 effort, 12 clicks total. Hamstring a bit tight at the end.
Zone 2 run along the canal, 14k, averaged 5:50 per km. Beautiful morning, felt great.
Shakeout 5 km before tomorrow's race, 30 min, legs fresh.
Tried 10 x 400 on the track but bailed after 7, side stitch and felt awful.
Long one today: two and a half hours on trails, about 24 km, lots of climbing. HR around 150. Tired but happy.
